RTK CLOUD / DATABASE DESIGN

Database Entity–Relationship Model

Traditional Crow’s-foot notation, organized around connected entities. The model covers 224 tables and 235 declared foreign-key relationships across five service-owned schema collections. Each relationship appears with both endpoints; repeated entities keep larger models readable.

How to read the model

Circle: zero · Bar: one · Crow’s foot: many. Each endpoint describes how many records at that end can relate to one record at the other end.

1 exactly one · 0..1 optional one · 0..* zero or more. PK marks primary-key attributes; FK marks actual foreign-key attributes. A PK/FK entity commonly resolves a many-to-many relationship.

Parent optionality comes from FK nullability. A unique child FK changes the child maximum from many to one. SQL foreign keys alone do not require a parent to have children. Dashed orange lines in Overall are documented logical mappings, not SQL FK.

Choose a service to inspect bounded relationship groups, then an entity or declared FK for its complete detail. Dashed lines are evidence-backed cross-service identifier mappings; they are not SQL foreign keys and imply no cardinality.

Cross-service logical references

  1. org → commercial account: Account Manager.organizations.id → Billing.commercial_accounts.organization_id. Billing explicitly stores the Account Manager organization UUID as an external identifier. Logical reference, not a database FK. Source: repos/rtk_billing/migrations/039_payment_commercial_settlement.sql.
  2. org → video device: Account Manager.organizations.id → Video Cloud.devices.org_id. The cross-service device contract carries org_id alongside the Video Cloud device identity. Logical reference, not a database FK. Source: repos/rtk_cloud_contracts_doc/cross_service_channel.md.
  3. account device → video device: Account Manager.devices.id → Video Cloud.devices.account_device_id. The account device UUID is persisted separately from the Video Cloud device ID. Logical reference, not a database FK. Source: repos/rtk_cloud_contracts_doc/product_readiness.md.

Details

Account Manager

88 entities · 124 declared relationships · 77 relationship models. Topical groups contain at most eight entities each and explain their data and operation context. Group membership is editorial, not a database relationship; an FK may point to an entity in another group.

Relationship groups

Organizations and sign-in identitiesRoles and access policyBrand Cloud membershipEnd users and device bindingsDevice and product registryClaiming and factory provisioningCloud ownership handoff preparationCloud ownership handoff decisionsCloud deletion preparationCloud deletion closurePlatform administration and governancePlatform service catalog and certificatesOutbound notifications and product collaborationTest labSchema versions

Group 1 · Organizations and sign-in identities 8 entities · 7 outgoing FK

Data scope: Organization, membership, human-account identity, and sign-in credentials.

When used: Used when creating organizations, inviting or disabling members, signing in, or linking identities.

organizations

Data: Primary organization and Brand Cloud records with type, quota, state, and metadata.

When used: Used when creating clouds or organizations, changing ownership, or applying lifecycle limits.

organization_members

Data: User roles, scopes, and disabled times within organizations.

When used: Used when members join, roles change, or organization access is checked.

users

Data: Human accounts with email, password, display name, and verification or disabled state.

When used: Used for registration, sign-in, verification, and account management.

user_identities

Data: Links between shared users and OIDC issuers and subjects.

When used: Used to find or link local accounts after external sign-in.

identity_providers

Data: OIDC issuer, client, and enablement settings.

When used: Used to configure or select an external sign-in provider.

oidc_login_states

Data: Hashed OIDC state and nonce values, redirects, and expiry.

When used: Used to validate callbacks and prevent replay after a sign-in redirect.

refresh_tokens

Data: Hashed refresh tokens and revocation times for shared users.

When used: Used to renew sign-in sessions or revoke them on logout.

auth_tokens

Data: Hashed verification or recovery tokens, purposes, and expiry times.

When used: Issued and consumed for email verification or account recovery.

Declared FK in this group · 7
  • auth_tokens_user_id_fkey: auth_tokens.user_id references users.id
  • oidc_login_states_provider_id_fkey: oidc_login_states.provider_id references identity_providers.id
  • organization_members_organization_id_fkey: organization_members.organization_id references organizations.id
  • organization_members_user_id_fkey: organization_members.user_id references users.id
  • refresh_tokens_user_id_fkey: refresh_tokens.user_id references users.id
  • user_identities_provider_id_fkey: user_identities.provider_id references identity_providers.id
  • user_identities_user_id_fkey: user_identities.user_id references users.id

Group 2 · Roles and access policy 7 entities · 12 outgoing FK

Data scope: Roles, permissions, scopes, and member activation.

When used: Used for authorization decisions, role assignment, external-group mapping, and access-policy updates.

roles

Data: Role names, scopes, system-role flags, and disabled state.

When used: Used when creating ACL roles or disabling old ones.

permissions

Data: Defined authorization capabilities by domain and action.

When used: Used to define or look up ACL capabilities.

role_permissions

Data: Many-to-many mappings from roles to permission definitions.

When used: Used to resolve capabilities granted by a role.

role_assignments

Data: Roles assigned to subjects, scopes, and organizations.

When used: Used when role grants are added, queried, or revoked.

external_group_mappings

Data: Rules mapping external groups to internal roles and scopes.

When used: Used when identity-provider groups are translated into account permissions.

Data: Test-device binding-token hashes, accounts, devices, and consumption state.

When used: Used to grant one-time device binding in the test environment.

test_lab_console_users

Data: Mappings between test console users and end-user identities.

When used: Used for test-console sign-in and identity integration.

test_lab_login_attempts

Data: Timestamps of test-account sign-in attempts.

When used: Defined for test-login throttling or audit; no direct non-DDL read or write path was found.

test_lab_sessions

Data: Short-lived test sessions tied to devices, products, and video device IDs.

When used: Used for test connections or operations and then expired or revoked.

Billing

55 entities · 71 declared relationships · 47 relationship models. Topical groups contain at most eight entities each and explain their data and operation context. Group membership is editorial, not a database relationship; an FK may point to an entity in another group.

Relationship groups

Commercial accounts and responsibilityPayments and automatic top-upsPricing, usage, and invoicesBilling handoff and settlementHandoff cancellation and archivalProvider reversalsBrand Cloud closureCloud creation and billing overviewPayment simulator

Group 1 · Commercial accounts and responsibility 7 entities · 9 outgoing FK

Data scope: Commercial accounts, balance entries, and financial-record responsibility periods.

When used: Used for posting funds, updating balances, restricting payment access, and identifying historical owners.

commercial_accounts

Data: Organization commercial accounts, currencies, available balances, and status.

When used: Used to open accounts, post funds, or restrict payments; organization UUID is the cross-service identifier.

balance_ledger_entries

Data: Immutable debit or credit entries with amounts and resulting balances for commercial accounts.

When used: Posted when payments, usage settlement, or refunds change a balance.

billing_responsibility_periods

Data: Effective account-responsibility intervals for an owner and version.

When used: Used during handoff or historical financial attribution queries.

billing_ledger_responsibility

Data: Responsibility periods and evidence assigned to balance entries.

When used: Determines who owns a historical ledger entry after a handoff.

billing_payment_responsibility

Data: Payment-intent responsibility periods and provenance.

When used: Identifies the responsible party during handoff or provider reversal.

billing_payment_method_responsibility

Data: Evidence linking payment methods to accounts and responsibility periods.

When used: Queried during owner transfers or payment-method revocation.

billing_access_states

Data: Organization billing eligibility, reason, and version.

When used: Consulted when allowing paid services or updating a restriction.

Group 2 · Payments and automatic top-ups 8 entities · 16 outgoing FK

Data scope: Payment methods, consent, intents, attempts, and reconciliation work.

When used: Used to set up a payment method, top up a balance, process provider callbacks, or reconcile uncertain outcomes.

payment_methods

Data: Provider payment methods, encrypted references, and masked details available to an account.

When used: Used to choose a payment instrument, top up automatically, or revoke a card.

payment_method_setup_sessions

Data: Payment-method setup sessions, provider references, and status.

When used: Used when adding a card, processing a callback, or cleaning up a failed setup.

payment_consents

Data: Accepted payment-consent text versions, acceptors, and revocation state.

When used: Checked before binding a payment method or enabling paid features.

payment_intents

Data: Account payment requests, amounts, providers, and current states.

When used: Created and advanced for automatic top-ups or manual payments.

payment_attempts

Data: Individual provider operations and normalized results for a payment intent.

When used: Recorded for charges, transaction inquiries, and retries.

payment_reconciliation_jobs

Data: Payment-intent follow-up inquiries, leases, retries, and errors.

When used: Reconciles missing callbacks or uncertain transaction outcomes.

payment_webhook_inbox

Data: Encrypted provider callback payloads, verification, and processing states.

When used: Receives, deduplicates, verifies, and retries provider webhooks.

auto_topup_policies

Data: Account thresholds, top-up amounts, limits, and selected payment methods.

When used: Evaluated when a balance falls below its threshold or a policy is disabled.

Group 3 · Pricing, usage, and invoices 8 entities · 10 outgoing FK

Data scope: Rate versions, billing periods, usage facts, and invoice artifacts.

When used: Used to ingest usage, price it, generate invoices, and link settlement ledger entries.

pricing_plan_versions

Data: Pricing-plan versions, currencies, effective windows, and status.

When used: Used to publish new prices or select the version applicable to a period.

pricing_rates

Data: Service and metric unit prices, units, and rounding rules under a plan version.

When used: Used to calculate usage charges and invoice lines.

billing_periods

Data: Organization billing intervals, pricing versions, locks, and closure times.

When used: Used to aggregate usage, calculate invoices, and settle each period.

billing_usage_facts

Data: Source usage IDs, service metrics, quantities, and metering windows.

When used: Deduplicated and included in a billing period when metering evidence arrives.

billing_invoices

Data: Invoice numbers, organizations or accounts, periods, and status.

When used: Used when closing a billing period, issuing an invoice, or querying it.

billing_invoice_lines

Data: Per-line invoice rates, usage, unit prices, and descriptions.

When used: Assembles priced usage into an explainable bill.

billing_invoice_documents

Data: Generated invoice bytes, hashes, and renderer versions.

When used: Used to generate, download, or verify an unchanged invoice document.

invoice_settlement_links

Data: Invoice-to-ledger settlement links and retry state.

When used: Used to offset an invoice with payments or balance entries and retry failed links.

Group 4 · Billing handoff and settlement 8 entities · 10 outgoing FK

Data scope: Balance snapshots, confirmations, authorization, and final decisions during ownership handoff.

When used: Used to freeze responsibility, confirm financial evidence, and commit or finalize an owner transfer.

billing_ownership_handoffs

Data: Source, target, and phase of a commercial-account ownership transfer.

When used: Created when Account Manager initiates a transfer and updated through preparation and commit.

billing_handoff_balance_snapshots

Data: Balance, currency, version, and cutoff snapshots for a handoff.

When used: Freezes a balance baseline before the new owner confirms financial responsibility.

billing_handoff_setup_observations

Data: Observed provider state of payment setup sessions during handoff.

When used: Checks whether incomplete card setup blocks a transfer.

billing_handoff_settlement_receipts

Data: Financial state, usage, and invoice checkpoint digests for handoff.

When used: Verifies that settlement covers the cutoff before transfer.

billing_handoff_confirmations

Data: User confirmation of a particular Billing snapshot version.

When used: Used when handoff parties confirm the balance and payment responsibility.

billing_handoff_commit_authorizations

Data: Commit authorization bound to a handoff and snapshot version.

When used: Permits the responsibility switch after the financial snapshot is confirmed.

billing_handoff_committed_decisions

Data: Account Manager ownership and responsibility versions after commit.

When used: Records the result and prevents duplicate or conflicting decisions.

billing_handoff_finalizations

Data: Final receipts and versions after a handoff completes.

When used: Confirms the responsibility-period switch is complete.

billing_handoff_cancellations

billing_handoff_abort_acknowledgments

billing_retired_profiles

billing_retired_policy_evidence

When used: Retains policy evidence after handoff or closure; populated by a database trigger.

billing_provider_reversal_allocations

Group 7 · Brand Cloud closure 8 entities · 10 outgoing FK

Data scope: Closure state, payment-credential revocations, settlement, and cancellation or completion receipts.

When used: Used when Brand Cloud deletion requires Billing to disable payer capabilities and confirm financial evidence.

billing_cloud_closures

Data: Commercial-account closure operation, original responsibility period, cutoff, and phase.

When used: Used while preparing, closing, or canceling Billing participation in Brand Cloud deletion.

billing_cloud_closure_revocations

Data: Fixed worklist of payment methods and setup sessions to revoke.

When used: Created at closure start to make revocation tasks immutable.

billing_cloud_closure_revocation_acks

Data: Provider receipts for revoked payment methods or setup sessions.

When used: Confirms each external payment capability has been disabled during closure.

billing_cloud_closure_settlements

Data: Financial closure evidence, usage, invoice, and provider checkpoints, and freshness.

When used: Created when a sufficiently current settlement snapshot is verified before closure.

billing_cloud_closure_completions

Data: Completed settlement, Account Manager readiness, and closure receipt digests.

When used: Saved when financial settlement has been verified and account capabilities are closed.

billing_cloud_closure_cancellations

Data: Closure cancellation IDs and Account Manager decision digests.

When used: Records cancellation evidence when cloud deletion is canceled before closure finishes.

billing_cloud_closure_release_acks

Data: Receipt digests for lifting a closure barrier after cancellation.

When used: Confirms Billing restored resource permissions before cancellation finishes.

billing_cloud_closure_retired_commands

Data: Invalidated closure commands and their previous receipts.

When used: Prevents an old command from closing an account after cancellation or recovery.

Video Cloud

64 entities · 37 declared relationships · 28 relationship models. Topical groups contain at most eight entities each and explain their data and operation context. Group membership is editorial, not a database relationship; an FK may point to an entity in another group.

Group 1 · Devices and connections 7 entities · 0 outgoing FK

Data scope: Video Cloud devices, live connections, commands, and runtime records.

When used: Used for device activation, connect/disconnect events, command delivery, and runtime-state recording.

devices

Data: Video Cloud device IDs, activation and online state, connections, and account mappings.

When used: Used for activation, connection, configuration changes, and cloud-state queries.

device_socket_sessions

Data: Active WebSocket or MQTT connections, serving instances, and last activity.

When used: Updated on device connection, heartbeat, or disconnect.

device_transfer_fences

Data: Cross-cloud transfer reservations and original organization or account IDs.

When used: Blocks conflicting device operations during ownership handoff.

device_presence_outbox

Data: Pending online/offline events and account mappings.

When used: Synchronizes presence to the account service after connection changes, with retries.

device_command_messages

Data: Payloads and creation times of queued device commands.

When used: Used to queue or resend device-control commands.

device_logs

Data: Basic device log event types, details, and occurrence times.

When used: Queried for device-operation and failure diagnosis.

device_runtime_logs

Data: Device runtime-log sequence, level, source, message, and attributes.

When used: Stored after device log submission for search and diagnosis.

  • No outgoing FK in this group; see linked entity for incoming relationships.

Group 2 · Events and runtime telemetry 7 entities · 0 outgoing FK

Data scope: Sequence gaps, product events, notification deduplication, and runtime settings.

When used: Used when accepting device events, tracking log sequences, retrying notifications, or validating tokens.

device_runtime_log_gaps

Data: Expected and actual sequence numbers missing from runtime-log streams.

When used: Recorded when an incoming device log skips a sequence number.

product_telemetry_events

Data: Product-level event schema, source, and account or device identifiers.

When used: Used to validate inbound telemetry and derive later product state.

device_event_acceptances

Data: Accepted device event IDs, types, and payload digests.

When used: Validates and deduplicates inbound events before downstream notifications.

notification_deliveries

Data: Deduplication keys and delivery times of successful notifications.

When used: Checked before sending to avoid duplicate delivery.

notification_dead_letters

Data: Failed notification IDs, attempt counts, and last errors.

When used: Retained for investigation after repeated delivery failure.

runtime_config

Data: Persistent Video Cloud key/value runtime settings.

When used: Read or written at startup or when a persistent setting changes.

refresh_tokens

Data: Video Cloud refresh tokens associated with principals and scopes.

When used: Used for Video Cloud API session renewal or expiration checks.

Group 3 · Video clips 3 entities · 1 outgoing FK

Data scope: Clip uploads, multipart integrity, and clip metadata.

When used: Used when a device uploads or resumes a clip, finalizes its parts, queries it, or expires it.

clip_uploads

Data: Clip-upload sessions, devices, time ranges, and status.

When used: Used when a device starts, finalizes, or aborts an upload.

clip_upload_parts

Data: Multipart upload part numbers, sizes, and checksums.

When used: Used to upload or resume parts and verify integrity before completion.

clip_metadata

Group 4 · OTA campaigns and dispatch 8 entities · 6 outgoing FK

Data scope: OTA releases, campaigns, target devices, dispatch throttles, and deployment outcomes.

When used: Used to create campaigns, schedule devices, send commands, atomically receive deployment events, or retain migration evidence.

ota_releases

Data: Product release identity, version, build, authoritative state and timestamps, internal revision, and extension-only payload.

When used: Used to create, publish, or revoke immutable firmware releases with revision-checked updates.

ota_campaigns

Data: Product and release links, authoritative campaign state and timestamps, internal revision, and extension-only payload.

When used: Revision-checked updates and ownership handoff prevent a stale writer from reviving canceled campaigns.

ota_campaign_targets

Data: Target device states, attempts, leases, and errors for campaigns.

When used: Used to schedule, dispatch, retry, or finish OTA work per device.

ota_campaign_dispatch_state

Data: Next permitted dispatch times for OTA campaigns.

When used: Updated while rate-limiting a campaign and scheduling its next device batch.

ota_global_dispatch_state

Data: Next globally permitted OTA dispatch time shared across campaigns.

When used: Enforces an overall OTA dispatch load limit.

ota_deployments

Data: Per-device status, event sequence, timestamps, internal revision, and extension-only payload.

When used: Event deduplication, sequence advancement, and status updates commit atomically; canceled work cannot be revived by stale updates.

ota_deployment_events

Data: Ordered event payloads reported for individual deployments.

When used: Deduplicates and tracks device-reported upgrade progress.

ota_legacy_migrations

Data: Retained legacy-to-Product OTA migration evidence.

When used: Preserves historical reconciliation metadata; offline cleanup blocks unresolved legacy records.

mqtt_usage_windows

usage_facts

When used: Validates metering events and prevents duplicate billing.

billing_usage_collector_receipts

When used: Prevents duplicate ingestion when a metering source is rescanned.

billing_usage_fact_outbox

When used: Reliably delivers accepted metering facts to Billing.

pki_issuers

pki_operations

When used: Used to submit issuer or trust changes that require approval.

pki_approvals

When used: Collects authorization evidence before root or issuer changes.

pki_audit

pki_certificate_bindings

pki_signing_claims

Data: Traceable device, cloud, and product claims for individual signing requests.

When used: Fixes and deduplicates identity scope during device-certificate issuance.

pki_replacements

Data: Old-to-new certificate or CSR replacements and overlap periods.

When used: Used to rotate certificates without interrupting services.

pki_legacy_imports

Data: Legacy PKI import operations and documents.

When used: Supports existing certificates and reviews migration evidence.
